issue_context.title: Move `auto_random` out of experimental features
issue_context.body:
## Development Task

Since the attribute `auto_random` is stable now, we can move the option `allow-auto-random` out of the [experimental] section in the configuration file.
comments: @tangenta will #16596 be cherry-picked to release-3.1 and -4.0?

@tangenta @kennytm  IMO this should *not* be cherry-picked to release-3.1 and release-4.0. Customers expect configuration options to be stable. Any customers using --config-strict and experimental/allow-auto-random will find that their clusters refuse to start after doing a minor version upgrade.

@kolbe I added this configuration option to the deprecated list. Now the old version clusters can be upgraded normally.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/18618

review_comments: is there any place checked with this `table is created with alter-primary-key enabled`?

https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/2bb1ff5a1efaec0cb38b575309091254df19d0b3/ddl/serial_test.go#L843

```go
	// PKIsNotHandle: table is created when alter-primary-key = true.
	config.GetGlobalConfig().AlterPrimaryKey = true
	assertPKIsNotHandle("create table t (a bigint auto_random(3) primary key, b int)", "a")
	assertPKIsNotHandle("create table t (a bigint auto_random(3) primary key, b int)", "a")
	assertPKIsNotHandle("create table t (a int, b bigint auto_random(3) primary key)", "b")
	config.GetGlobalConfig().AlterPrimaryKey = false
```

got, 
there is not explicit AlterPrimaryKey judgement, when this is on, pk is not handle indeed.
Do we need to update this function name? This function doesn't handle `AutoRandom` related configurations now.
This is only used in `auto_random` tests and it does set up the config. I think no need to update.
